community_list_entries.name: IMPLEXCONV
Toward Multi-Session Personalized Conversation: A Large-Scale Dataset and Hierarchical Tree Framework for Implicit Reasoning

phase1_classification.kind_reason: ImplexConv (arXiv 2503.07018) is a long-term dataset of 2,500 examples, each about 100 conversation sessions. It is built to test implicit reasoning over personalized multi-session dialogue history. The paper also proposes the TaciTree method.
